EPISODE NUMBER: Episode 7
EPISODE LOGLINE: At the engagement party Selene accuses Nadia of stealing the Kellan sapphire, and security demands her bag.
CONTINUITY NOTES: Picking up at the Episode 6 cliffhanger: Grant plans to plant the necklace at the party.
